title: Monthly Speed Comparisons
description: For route performance comparing the latest full year to all-time, and analyzing the performance by month for the latest year.
_note: Reconstructed via --from-page 2210632. Dates were already correctly live from the earlier working round. KNOWN, ALREADY-DOCUMENTED platform limit, not attempted here: 'Trailing 6-Year Average' (year-2year->... wait, year-5year->6year, a 6-year window) can exceed ClickHouse's query-size limit — see dynamic-reports-and-route-tags.md's open questions. Dropped 2 of 9 graphs ('Average Speed by Peak', 'Hours of Delay by Peak') — both are Bar Graph Summary panels needing AM/PM/Off-Peak sub-routes that no longer exist (zero overlap with current routes, confirmed via live routeIds). UNLIKE the fully-dropped Bar-Graph-Summary cases elsewhere, this one has a real, NOT YET VERIFIED path to rebuild properly: report-spec.md documents startTime/endTime as a per-ROUTE spec field (report_build.mjs's own 'wire route -> graph' comment: 'weekdays/startTime/endTime are still spec'd per-route'), so 3 slot routes sharing the SAME dateFormula but different startTime/endTime (AM/PM/Off-Peak sub-windows of Current Year) could in principle recreate 3 real comparisonSeries arms without any dead route. NOT attempted here because report_build.mjs's own slot-write path doesn't currently thread startTime/endTime through for slot routes at all (only the concrete-route branch does), and it's unverified whether resolveRouteDates' formula-resolved (bare-date) output correctly recombines with a separately-carried startTime/endTime downstream — verify before relying on this, don't assume. **UPDATE 2026-08-14**: the underlying blocker this note describes is gone — weekdays/startTime/endTime moved off routes[] entirely onto graphs[]/routeWindows (see dynamic-reports-and-route-tags.md's 'Per-route window overrides' section), so the old 'slot routes don't thread startTime/endTime' concern doesn't apply (that field never lives on a route anymore, slot or otherwise). The 2 dropped Bar Graph Summary panels (AM/PM/Off-Peak) are now genuinely buildable via routeWindows array-expansion on Current Year, same mechanism proven on snapshot.json's bar_speed_peak_summary/bar_delay_peak_summary — NOT built in this pass (this session's scope was the mechanical routes[]->graphs[] migration only), flagged as a real, ready-to-build follow-up.
